name: platform-django
description: Provisioning a prototype: one command against this manifest. Buildpack order is frontend then Python, because the landing page is served by Django from collected static files. Graduating a tier is a diff to this file plus a scale command.

PROJECT_SLUG.description: Names this project's resources. Nothing in the template is renamed, so this is what distinguishes one project from another.

PROJECT_DISPLAY_NAME.description: What a user reads: page titles, the landing page, the API schema, the from-address on an email.

DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE.description: manage.py defaults to local settings, so the deploy has to say otherwise.

DJANGO_ADMIN_URL.description: Path the admin is mounted at. Generated per app so it is not guessable.

DJANGO_ALLOWED_HOSTS.description: Hosts Django will answer for. The leading dot matches any subdomain; add your own domain when you attach one.

DJANGO_API_SERVER_URL.description: Optional. Public base URL of this app, used by tools that generate API code samples from the OpenAPI schema.

DJANGO_SECURE_HSTS_SECONDS.description: Optional. How long browsers are told to require HTTPS. Defaults to a minute; raise it to 518400 once the short window has held.

SENTRY_DSN.description: Optional. Error reporting is off while this is unset.

MAILGUN_API_KEY.description: Optional. Without it, mail is written to the dyno log instead of being sent.

MAILGUN_DOMAIN.description: Optional. The Mailgun sending domain, used only when MAILGUN_API_KEY is set.
